title: Edge on Top - Wrong Side
long_name: LBL Daisy - Top Edge Wrong Orientation
notes: Most common mistake - edge is on top but white faces the side. Remove it and put it back correctly.
story: The white edge is almost there, but twisted the wrong way. We need to take it out and put it back correctly.
description: White edge already on top but white sticker faces the side. Remove it and bring it back correctly.

title: Middle Edge - White Front
long_name: LBL Daisy - Middle Layer White Facing Front
notes: White edge in middle layer with white facing front. Rotate top to position, then extract upward.
story: The white edge is in the middle with white facing you. Rotate the top layer to make space, then bring it up to the daisy.
description: White edge in middle layer with white facing front. Use U' R to bring it to the top.

title: Middle Edge - White Side
long_name: LBL Daisy - Middle Layer White Facing Side
notes: Simplest case - white edge in middle with white facing the side. One front turn brings it to the top.
story: The white edge is in the middle with white facing the side. A simple counterclockwise front turn brings it up to join the daisy.
description: White edge in middle layer with white facing side. Use F' to bring it to the top.

title: Bottom Edge - White Front
long_name: LBL Daisy - Bottom Layer White Facing Front
notes: White edge on bottom with white sticker facing you. Move it away, rotate top, then flip up.
story: The white edge is on the bottom with white facing forward. We move it to the side, rotate the top to make space, then flip it up to join the daisy.
description: White edge on bottom with white facing front. Use F' U' R to bring it to the top.

title: Bottom Edge - White Down
long_name: LBL Daisy - Bottom Layer White Facing Down
notes: Easiest case - white edge on bottom face with white facing down. Two turns flip it directly to the top.
story: The white edge is on the bottom, white side down. A double turn (F2) flips it straight to the top to join the daisy.
description: White edge on bottom with white facing down. Two turns flip it to the top.

title: First Layer Corner
notes: Fundamental algorithm - appears throughout solving. Practice until it feels natural.
story: The base algorithm: right, up, left, down. Most important algorithm to learn.
description: Insert white corner into correct position. Repeat until all four corners are solved.

title: Middle Edge Left
scramble: U' L' U L U F U' F'
notes: Edge goes to the left. Watch the top center color to know which side to solve.
story: Up-prime, left-prime, up, left, up, front, up-prime, front-prime
description: Insert middle layer edge when it needs to go left

title: Middle Edge Right
scramble: U R U' R' U' F' U F
notes: Edge goes to the right. Mirror of the left algorithm.
story: Up, right, up-prime, right-prime, up-prime, front-prime, up, front
description: Insert middle layer edge when it needs to go right

title: Sitting (L-Shape)
scramble: F R U R' U' F'
notes: Two yellow edges form an L-shape. Position L on the left before applying. FUR says URF - easiest case, apply once.
story: L-shape sits in the corner - just one application needed
description: Two adjacent yellow edges oriented forming L-shape

title: Lying (I-Shape)
scramble: F R U R' U' F' F R U R' U' F'
notes: Two opposite yellow edges form an I-shape line. Apply algorithm twice.
story: I-shape lies flat - needs two applications to stand up
description: Two opposite yellow edges oriented forming I-shape

title: Standing (Dot-Shape)
long_name: LBL Top Cross - Standing Dot Pattern
scramble: (F R U R' U' F') (F R U R' U' F') U' (F R U R' U' F')
notes: No yellow edges oriented - only center visible (dot). Apply algorithm once, rotate top (U), then apply twice more consecutively.
story: The dot stands alone in the center - needs special sequence: 1x + U + 2x
description: No yellow edges oriented - only center showing as dot

title: Sune
scramble: R U R' U R U2 R'
notes: Sune algorithm - very common. Apply 0-6 times to orient all corners.
story: Right, up, right-prime, up, right, double-up, right-prime
description: Orient yellow corners using the Sune algorithm

title: Corner Swap
scramble: R' F R' B2 R F' R' B2 R2 U'
notes: Longer algorithm but only needs 1 application. Hold with solved pair on front.
description: Permute yellow corners to correct positions

title: Edge Cycle
scramble: F2 U L R' F2 L' R U F2
notes: Final algorithm - cycles three edges. Hold solved edge on back.
description: Permute yellow edges to solve the cube

title: Corner Helper
notes: Helper algorithm to position white corners before insertion. Optional but useful.
description: Move white corner from bottom layer to top without disrupting solved pieces
